text: Scheduling refinement superseding the earlier linear RRA 0 to RRA 1 to RRA 2 wording: when RRA 0 closes, RRA 1 and RRA 2 become ready together. The Track-A epic is blocked by both and owns their integration audit; RRA 3 remains blocked by Track A. This preserves the architectural gates while allowing the independent response-kernel and archive-resource work to proceed concurrently.
